raw_row.What's your level of experience with rob: My background is in embedded systems, automation, and large-scale technical infrastructure projects. I currently work on complex AI-driven testing and data analysis environments involving mobile automation, performance monitoring, and system reliability.  Robotics and intelligent systems have always been a field I dreamed of working in. I’m especially interested in the convergence of AI and robotics, particularly autonomous systems, perception, simulation, and real-world deployment powered by accelerated computing platforms like NVIDIA. I’m attending to deepen my understanding of modern robotics and connect with others building the next generation of intelligent systems.
